messages:
Jae Park: Quick thought 1: lunchtime ramen pop-up this Friday in the courtyard? we could do a small stacked rotation so folks can grab a bowl between meetings. f35c
Mina Soto: love it. is it bring-your-own bowl or vendor drop?
Jae Park: thinking short vendor pop-up (local ramen place) + a karaoke afterwork option for anyone who wants to keep hanging. low-key.
Omar Khan: vendor + karaoke = yes. what time for the karaoke? after work at ~6:30?
Lena Fitzgerald: 6:30 works. can we do a quick poll: 3 thumbs up = in for karaoke, 3 wave = maybe, 3 x = not tonight.
OpsBot: Event draft created: "Ramen Pop-up + Karaoke" Friday lunch + 18:30 afterparty. Reminder set 2h before lunch and 1h before karaoke.
Mina Soto: also note: vendor needs a minimum order for delivery. if we hit 30 orders they'll deliver; otherwise we can do pick-up.
Ravi Menon: i'll coordinate orders if people drop preferences here (shoyu/tonkotsu/veggie).
Becca Li: i44d shoyu or veggie for me.
Omar Khan: tonkotsu for me.
Jae Park: logistics: drop your meal below and react to the karaoke poll. I'll collect and send to Ravi by noon Thursday.
Mina Soto: question: budget? can company cover light catering or should folks pay?
Jae Park: thinking people pay vendor directly (cashless payment) but small company subsidy possible if we reach a certain headcount; checking with Ops.
Lena Fitzgerald: Karaoke devils: whos bringing the speaker / mic?
Omar Khan: i can bring a portable speaker and mic.
Ravi Menon: tally: Jae (shoyu), Mina (veggie), Becca (shoyu), Omar (tonkotsu), Lena (maybe karaoke).
Lena Fitzgerald: recs for karaoke playlist? short upbeat tracks.
Becca Li: rec: "Ain't No Mountain" for a group singalong.
Mina Soto: allergen note: vendor will pack eggs separately on request. please flag allergies when ordering.
Jae Park: Karaoke poll: drop 44d if you'll stay for karaoke, 3b6 if maybe, 6ab if no.
OpsBot: Reminder: please RSVP for vendor order by Thursday 12:00 to secure delivery.
Ravi Menon: will send order form link by EOD today.
Becca Li: 44d for karaoke
Omar Khan: 44d for karaoke
Mina Soto: 3b6 maybe (depends on evening plans)
Jae Park: perfect. thanks everyone 60a i'll post the order link and karaoke sign-up later today.
